content: How do I reset my password? Go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password', then follow the emailed link.
Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of login security by requiring a code from your phone.
Locked accounts are automatically unlocked after one hour of the last failed login attempt.
You can update your email address from Account Settings under the Profile tab.
Deactivating your account pauses billing but keeps your data intact for 90 days.
